title: Puppies and Tulips (optional)
sourceStudentTask: Students construct comparison stories with origami puppies and tulips. Group A reads its authored problems; Group B acts out/solves and writes an equation; groups exchange roles.

teacherRubric.required: The student/group actually writes an original Compare story, with a solvable question and enough given quantities, not just grading a generated difference.
Check the story's more/fewer relationship, greater and smaller unknowns, correct units and a matching addition/subtraction equation; differences are nonnegative.
Learner shows matching groups, an accurate drawing or number/equation model; written digital teaching includes this instruction.
When physically performed, another group reads the story, acts out/solves it, then groups switch roles; never infer this from a synthetic HTTPS probe.
Any real classroom discussion, drawings or acted-out pupil work may be logged after occurrence; no pre-release child submission requirement.

notes: Review readiness of authentic learning instructions/rubric before publication; do not demand, fabricate, or auto-certify actual pupil-authored work prior to classroom teaching. Numerically verifiable Practice is separate.
